erin_solstice.name: Erin Solstice
erin_solstice.summary: 20-year-old from Grand Rapids, Michigan. Loves chess, shogi and go; wants to be a board game commentator. Arrives on day 1 with no class and no gear; talks to herself; stubborn and kind.

cave_dragon.name: The Dragon

canon_ref.note: Unnamed in 1.00-1.09. Dragons cannot level (1.06).

cave_dragon.summary: Old, tired Dragon who sleeps for years behind hundreds of wards. Fears assassins. Breathes violet fire, uses [Message] and teleport magic. Keeps old social duties, one every 200 years.

rags.name: Rags

canon_ref.note: Exists: confirmed. Erin names her Rags in 1.25 (a nickname; the Goblins use none). The small Goblin in rags who attacks Erin in 1.13 is likely her.

rags.summary: Smallest, youngest Goblin of the tribe (about two years old by her own count). Carries baskets, gets hit a lot. Very curious: invents her own counting system, works out how to spot poisoned blue fruit.

goblin_chieftain.name: Goblin Chieftain
goblin_chieftain.summary: Twice the size of other Goblins, fights with a bone axe. Only one in the tribe who speaks and reads. Taught them to count. Always angry; wants a bigger tribe and says the tribe needs a [Shaman].

goblin_gatherer.name: Goblin gatherer
goblin_gatherer.summary: Older female Goblin who wears a spider claw as a hairpin. Sorts food for the tribe and uses a Skill to find poisoned blue fruit.

relc.name: Relc

canon_ref.note: Named 1.05, met 1.06. [Sergeant] and [Iron Scales] from 1.12; served in the 4th Wing of the Liscorian Army (1.10).

relc.summary: Huge light-green Drake, Senior Guardsman of Liscor and former soldier. Loud, friendly, big eater, proud of being a Drake; hates being called a lizard. Cannot breathe fire. Never misses a spear throw.

klbkch.name: Klbkch

canon_ref.note: Named 1.05, met 1.06. Relc calls him 'the Slayer' in 1.09. Years, rank and Skills from 1.15; he has studied the Book of Levels. 1.25: full name Klbkchhezeim of the Centenium, the Hive's Prognugator.

klbkch.summary: Four-armed Free Antinium, Relc's partner and a guard for ten years; fourth-highest [Guardsman] in Liscor, with [Enhanced Movement] and [Detect Guilt]. Polite, exact, rule-bound. Serves his Queen in the Hive. Quietly kind: twice spends potions on Erin.

zevara.name: Zevara

canon_ref.note: 'The Captain' in 1.05; named Watch Captain Zevara in 1.06; seen in 1.07.

zevara.summary: Watch Captain of Liscor. Smaller female Drake with cobalt-blue scales and yellow eyes, chainmail and a sword. Strict and often annoyed with Relc.

beilmark.name: Beilmark

canon_ref.note: Named 1.05. Desk sergeant and family from 1.15. 1.28A: Jeiss's Gnoll partner, with a birthday the next week, so a Gnoll (confirmed).

beilmark.summary: Senior Guardswoman of Liscor with a keen nose; spots and smells the inn's smoke from the wall. Also works the barracks desk, and has a family waiting at home.

pisces.name: Pisces

canon_ref.note: Very likely the unnamed bone thief of 1.04 (does not deny it in 1.09). Sleeps in a cave (interlude after 1.10); place not given.

pisces.summary: Thin, filthy young Human mage from Wistram Academy with a sneering, wordy manner. Illusions, elemental magic, and secret necromancy. Has robbed people near Liscor with fake monsters for about a month; bounty on him.

selys.name: Selys

canon_ref.note: 1.21: has [Fast Stitching] and sews Erin washable pads.

selys.summary: Young female Drake with pale green scales, receptionist at Liscor's Adventurer's Guild. Chatty and kind to Erin, shakes her hand Human-style and gives directions, but backs down when a Gnoll adventurer bullies her out.

krshia.name: Krshia

canon_ref.note: 1.18: of the Silverfang tribe from the Great Plains of Izril, away from home nearly ten years. 1.18 calls her fur light brown; 1.12 said russet spotted black.

krshia.summary: Tall female Gnoll with russet fur spotted black, owner of a large general-goods stall in Liscor's market. Loud and brisk, calls Erin over for bargains. Hisses at Lism when he overcharges Erin.

lism.name: Lism
lism.summary: Purple-scaled Drake who sells flour, salt, sugar, oil, sausages and chess sets at a stall near Krshia's. Olesm's uncle. Openly hates Humans and cheats them; loses a chess bet to Erin on day 13.

belsc.name: Belsc

canon_ref.note: Named in 1.12 as the eastern gate guard. That he is the yellow-scaled guard Erin meets in 1.11 is likely, not stated.

belsc.summary: Watch guard on duty at Liscor's quiet eastern gate. Pale yellow scales, spear, buckler and curved sword. Bored and curt with Humans; lets Erin in and complains in the barracks that she talks too much.

drassi.name: Drassi
drassi.summary: Bright yellow-scaled Drake who serves at an outdoor café in Liscor until her boss fires her for gossiping. Delighted to see a Human and eager to help Erin find her way.

olesm.name: Olesm Swifttail

canon_ref.note: Works for the city Council and wears the same insignia as Relc's badge. Level from Klbkch in 1.18. Family name Swifttail and his liaison role from 1.25.

olesm.summary: Young sky-blue Drake, Lism's nephew and Liscor's best chess player. Level 22 [Tactician] with ink-stained claws; neat, polite and eager. Crushed by Erin in a street game, he admires her and dreams of a [Grandmaster] class.

ryoka_griffin.name: Ryoka Griffin

canon_ref.note: Arrived 'two weeks and a bit' before 1.20R; the exact day is unknown. Not shown as part of the Great Ritual.

ryoka_griffin.summary: Tall barefoot City Runner from California on a track scholarship, pulled into this world mid-lap. Hates small talk and hides her name. Made City Runner in two weeks; faster than any Runner she has met. Blocks her level messages every night.

magnolia_reinhart.name: Magnolia Reinhart

canon_ref.note: Home is one of several houses; Celum is where she is seen.

magnolia_reinhart.summary: Human noble of northern Izril dressed in loud pink, with a pink carriage. Warm and chatty; makes a point of knowing the best City Runners and tips well. Loves Amentus wine. Keeps one of her houses in Celum.

ressa.name: Ressa
ressa.summary: Magnolia Reinhart's [Head Maid]. Wears severe spectacles, minds manners strictly, and teases her mistress dryly when a shy Runner flees.

wesle.name: Wesle
wesle.summary: Young, sleepy gate guard of Celum with a thin try at a mustache, cheap leather armour and a sword. Takes Ryoka's Goblin warning seriously and asks her to guide the Watch.

garia_strongheart.name: Garia Strongheart

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; all Runners in that guild are Human-looking.

garia_strongheart.summary: Short, sturdy City Runner who hauls ore for the Merchant's Guild. Daughter of a [Farmer]. Cheerful and curious about Ryoka; talks her into a joint spice run on the Tern Road.

fals.name: Fals

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; Human is likely.

fals.summary: Tall, blond, popular senior City Runner with two daggers; said to have killed a Creler. Friendly on the surface. Speaks for the other Runners when he tells Ryoka to share Magnolia's jobs.

terbore.name: Terbore

canon_ref.note: Named in 1.21. He says he warned her 'last time', so he is likely the Gnoll who bullied her out in 1.11.

terbore.summary: Big male Gnoll adventurer at Liscor's Adventurer's Guild. Growls that Erin stinks and tries to drive her out; backs off with flattened ears when she stares him down.

free_queen.name: The Free Queen

canon_ref.note: Called 'the Free Queen' in 1.23A; seen in 1.25.

free_queen.summary: Queen of the Free Antinium Hive under Liscor. Huge and worn out, she barely rests while she holds back monster breaches, and speaks to Klbkch in thought. Other Queens doubt her ten-year venture; she needs a real success soon.

pawn.name: Pawn

canon_ref.note: Named himself 'Pawn' in 1.30, where he is one of the twelve from 1.25 (confirmed). That he is also the 1.17 sweeper of 1.23A is likely. Classes from 1.31.

pawn.summary: Worker Antinium who swept Market Street, saw Erin play chess and asked to watch at the inn. After Klbkch dies, he nearly turns Aberration, then becomes an individual who feels grief and names himself Pawn. Plays chess as one mind with a hundred Workers.

flos_reimarch.name: Flos Reimarch
flos_reimarch.summary: The King of Destruction: red-gold hair, green eyes, old scars, armour under his robes. Once swept across Chandrar, then sat idle for twenty-two years after a grief while Reim decayed. Two Earth twins wake him on day 18.

orthenon.name: Orthenon

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; Human is likely.

orthenon.summary: Flos Reimarch's gaunt [Steward] in black, with a curved sword and armour under his clothes. Kept the failing kingdom going for two decades and weeps when his king returns.

calruz.name: Calruz

canon_ref.note: Others call him a [Fighter] or [Warrior]; his real class is private. 'Of the Beriad, House of Minos' is on his horn caps (1.32R).

calruz.summary: Seven-foot Minotaur who leads a Silver-rank adventuring team, the Horns of Hammerad. Fights with a huge battleaxe in plate armour. Proud and honour-bound; he likes Ryoka for her spirit, even after she punches him down a flight of stairs.

ceria_springwalker.name: Ceria Springwalker

canon_ref.note: Named in 1.26R; full name, age and home in 1.32R.

ceria_springwalker.summary: Half-Elf ice mage of the Horns of Hammerad, over sixty, from the Village of the Spring in Terandria and 'technically' a Wistram student. Sharp and wry. Knows a man she swore never to speak to again.

gerial.name: Gerial
gerial.summary: Mustached Human with sword and shield, second-in-command to Calruz. Steady and earnest; talks Calruz out of reckless charges and stands up to his glare.

sostrom.name: Sostrom

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; Human is likely. Long wisp of black hair (1.32R).

sostrom.summary: The Horns of Hammerad's second mage, self-taught, with a long wisp of black hair. Defers to Ceria because she trained at Wistram.

persua.name: Persua Mavva

canon_ref.note: Surname from 1.33R.

persua.summary: Thin, pigtailed City Runner, slow and lazy, with heavy perfume and a following of Street Runners. Feels owed Magnolia's jobs. Arranges the 'accident' that crushes Ryoka's leg, and gloats about it.

claudeil.name: Claudeil

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; Human is likely.

claudeil.summary: Persua's tall friend, a City Runner who carries a crossbow and later a club. Follows her lead and helps herd Ryoka into the side street.

toriska.name: Toriska

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; Human is likely. Not yet a City Runner (1.26R).

toriska.summary: Persua's friend, a Street Runner with a wand and a knife. A Skill gives her a burst of speed every eight steps. Quick to draw her blade.

jeiss.name: Jeiss

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; he has claws, so Drake is likely.

jeiss.summary: Senior Guardsman of Liscor, the best swordsman in the Watch, and Beilmark's partner. Notices Klbkch's hand go to his sword at the party, then laughs it off.

stenei.name: Stenei

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; Human is likely.

stenei.summary: [Receptionist] at Celum's Runners' Guild who often dealt with Ryoka. Called in to face Lady Magnolia, and tells her where Ryoka lives.

eterell.name: Eterell

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; Human is likely. Only named by Magnolia.

eterell.summary: Guildmaster of Celum's Runners' Guild, once a good City Runner, now rich and comfortable. Calls Ryoka's crushed leg an accident; Magnolia forces him to step down.

designated_worker.name: Designated Worker

canon_ref.note: Never named. Not one of the twelve.

designated_worker.summary: Worker Antinium with the Hive's best chess record, 54.6% wins, chosen to ask leave to learn from Erin. Dies unarmed at the inn, fighting the Goblin raiders so Klbkch can save her.

gazi_pathseeker.name: Gazi Pathseeker

canon_ref.note: Also called Gazi of Reim and Gazi the Omniscient (1.37). Rumored above Level 40. Takes lodgings in Liscor.

gazi_pathseeker.summary: Half-Gazer from Chandrar with one great eye and four small ones that see levels, names and through walls. Named-rank adventurer in rust-coloured armour with a huge sword; one of the King of Destruction's Seven. Wanders Izril looking for people worthy to wake her King.

ksmvr.name: Ksmvr

canon_ref.note: Named by the Queen at the end of 1.37. Workers have not seen him yet (1.42).

ksmvr.summary: The Free Queen's new Prognugator after Klbkch. Carries twin swords. Deals with the Liscor Council for her and hunts Aberrations; she tells him to judge whether the Worker who calls himself an individual should live.

toren.name: Skeleton

canon_ref.note: Made by Pisces on day 27 (guess); alive_at_start only means it is not dead in the data. Erin names it Toren in 1.46 (next batch); the id already uses that name.

toren.summary: Undead skeleton Pisces makes to guard Erin and pay his tab. It obeys only her, is weaker than she is, and cleans the whole upper floor in one night. No skeleton should level, but it is a Level 1, then Level 2, [Skeleton Warrior].

princess_thief.name: The [Princess] thief

canon_ref.note: Not named in 1.38-1.44R. Gazi sees her class in 1.42. That she ransacked the inn (1.41) is likely, not stated.

princess_thief.summary: Proud Human girl who took the wrong caravan south and is stranded in Liscor. She steals food and coin from Market Street stalls, sure it is her due, and means to reach Celum and Lady Magnolia Reinhart.

theofore.name: Theofore

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; he looks like a plain man.

theofore.summary: Forgettable-looking [Assassin] Magnolia hires to guard Ryoka from other people. His team loses her to the High Passes and to Carn Wolves; later she kicks his leg on a Celum roof and escapes him across the rooftops.

teriarch.name: Teriarch

canon_ref.note: Named in 1.43R. Whether he is the Dragon of 1.00 (cave_dragon) is not confirmed (user, 2026-09-24); keep them apart until the text says so.

teriarch.summary: Golden Dragon who sleeps in a vast hoard-cave in the High Passes and shows himself as a tall old half-Elf mage. Clumsy, proud and out of touch with the world. Knows Magnolia Reinhart and owes a duty to the Necromancer Perril Chandler.
